description.fallback: Caesar's Ripple proves to be far stronger than Wamuu had predicted. Wamuu tries to retreat within the hotel, but Caesar cuts his legs with a Bubble Cutter and plans on finishing him with a Ripple Kick. However, Wamuu purposely fell back so that the kick's impact would knock him into the hotel.

intro.fallback: Caesar's Ripple proves to be far stronger than Wamuu had predicted.
Wamuu tries to retreat within the hotel, but Caesar cuts his legs with a Bubble Cutter and plans on finishing him with a Ripple Kick.

text.fallback: Head out: Caesar: A Lonely Youth, Part 4

outro.fallback: Caesar reveals that his Cutters can act like lenses, refracting the sunlight and magnifying it in Wamuu's position.
Wamuu freezes in place when Caesar goes in for the finishing blow, but for a single instant, Wamuu was within Caesar's shadow, allowing him to pull off a devastating Divine Sandstorm.
